# InsightFlow AI 📊

**Exploratory analysis, made accessible.** Upload a UTF-8 CSV to get data-quality checks, descriptive statistics, and automatically generated charts. With an optional Google Gemini API key, ask follow-up questions about the computed aggregates.

> **Privacy:** Use non-sensitive data only. Raw CSV files are processed locally; enabling Gemini sends aggregated feature statistics and up to two generated charts to Google's API. Review the data governance and API terms before using it with third-party information.

**Try it:** Upload `data/sample_sales.csv` to explore the workflow.
